So the recursive shape is left untyped here (`any`) and cast at // each read site inside . export type TreeNode = any; static const CHANGES: ChangedFile[] = [ { file: "README.md", state: "M" }, { file: "api/hello/route.ts", state: "U" }, { file: "app/layout.tsx", state: "M" }, ]; static const FILE_TREE: TreeNode[] = [ [ "app", ["api", ["hello", ["route.ts"]], "page.tsx", "layout.tsx", ["blog", ["page.tsx"]]], ], ["components", ["ui", "button.tsx", "card.tsx"], "header.tsx", "footer.tsx"], ["lib", ["util.ts"]], ["public", "favicon.ico", "vercel.svg"], ".eslintrc.json", ".gitignore", "next.config.js", "tailwind.config.js", "package.json", "README.md", ]; // Recursive file/folder tree, following the same recursive pattern // as ui/tree-view/tree-view.marko. Our sidebar sub-parts have no // SidebarMenuSub equivalent yet, so nested levels are composed here from // Collapsible + a plain
